overview: The Manipal Academy MAHE Innovation Grants scheme is part of the Grants Office at the Directorate of Research, Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE). It aims to support MAHE faculty and researchers in identifying, applying for, and managing external research grants to improve research outcomes and funding quality. The scheme provides services such as grant proposal writing workshops, assistance with documentation, legal consultations, and coordination with funding agencies to enhance the success rate of grant applications.
objectives: Identify, apply and secure external grants
Improve the quantum & quality of the grant proposal
Aid in improving the strike rate of application
Support and educate researchers on grant proposal writing and funding trends
Assist applicants with necessary approvals, consultations, policies & documents
Establish linkage with funding agencies to understand funding trends
Nurture interdisciplinary collaborations within MAHE institutions
eligibility: MAHE faculty and research scholars are eligible to avail services from the Grants Office. The office supports researchers in enhancing the quantum and quality of research funding through pre-award and post-award management processes.
benefits: Services include quick identification of grant calls, customized email notifications, improving time and quality spent on proposals through budgeting and mentorship, assistance with mandatory documents and institutional approvals, conducting grant proposal writing workshops, legal consultation for MOUs/Agreements, review of unsuccessful proposals for re-submission, and management of research funds with financial auditing.
financial_support: The Grants Office assists in managing research funds and financial auditing of research accounts during the grant implementation stage. It coordinates between PI and finance, purchase, legal, and HR teams as needed. However, the scheme itself does not provide direct financial support; it facilitates access to external grants from funding agencies.
application_process: 1. Identify relevant grant calls through the Grants Office’s notification system. 2. Receive customized emails about open calls. 3. Utilize services such as budgeting, mentorship, and proposal review for guidance. 4. Prepare mandatory documents and coordinate institutional approvals and signatures. 5. Attend grant proposal writing workshops if needed. 6. Seek legal consultation while signing MOUs/Agreements. 7. Submit the grant application. 8. If unsuccessful, request review and suggestions for re-submission at alternative agencies. 9. Upon award, manage funds and undergo financial auditing through the Grants Office finance team.
deadlines: Rolling basis — grants are supported as calls are open from various funding agencies.
implementing_agency: Directorate of Research, Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE)
caveats: The Grants Office does not provide direct funding; it facilitates access to external grants.
Support is contingent on the availability of grant calls from external funding agencies.
Researchers must comply with institutional policies and documentation requirements.
